title: Great Value - Great Price
body:
Checker is a great, affordable habit tracker!

3 things I like about it:

1. Simple & clean, yet powerful setup of habits!

2. Great widget support - Put all your habits in a stack, and you can take care of them from your home screen!

3. One time payment, and a great developer, following a roadmap full of nice upgrades in the future!

All in all worth every penny!
author: Frederik V.
